title: GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers: Pre-Order Guide
description: Get ready for GTA 6 with the newly announced limited edition PS5 controllers. Check out the pre-order details for US and UK, designs, and release date.

content:
## GTA 6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers: Pre-Order Guide and Design Details

As the highly anticipated release of *Grand Theft Auto VI* draws closer, Sony and Rockstar Games have teamed up to offer fans a special way to gear up. According to reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, two limited-edition PS5 controllers themed around GTA 6 have been officially revealed, with pre-order links now rolling out in the US and UK.

For fans looking to secure their hardware ahead of time, here is everything you need to know about the new controllers and their release.

### Design and Features

The collaboration brings two distinct colorways for players to choose from, blending the sleek hardware of the PS5 DualSense with the vibrant aesthetic of the game's setting:

* **Color Options**: The controllers are available in a choice of black or white base designs.
* **Neon Accents**: Both controllers sport a striking blue and purple faceplate surrounding the thumbsticks and touchpad, evoking a distinct Miami-style neon vibe.
* **Thematic Details**: The GTA 6 logo is prominently printed directly onto the touchpad. Additionally, both handles feature subtle palm tree indentations, nodding to the game's tropical atmosphere.

### Release Date and Pre-Orders

Timing is everything for collectors and fans eager to dive into the new title:

* **Release Date**: Both limited-edition controllers will launch on the exact same day as the game: **19th November 2026**.
* **Pre-Order Availability**: Pre-order links for the US and UK markets are currently live, giving players an early opportunity to lock in their purchases.

Industry analysts and observers note that given the monumental cultural impact of the GTA franchise, limited-edition hardware of this caliber tends to see extremely high demand. If you are planning to add these to your collection, acting quickly during the pre-order window is strongly recommended.

## Editor's Take

Teaming up for themed hardware is a classic move, but the design touches on these GTA 6 PS5 controllers—from the blue and purple faceplates to the palm tree grips—genuinely capture the vibe of the game. Launching alongside the title on November 19, 2026, they are shaping up to be a must-have for dedicated fans. If you want one, don't sleep on the pre-orders.
